# Lantern Sync 3.8.0

## What changed

This release speeds up large uploads and adds a setting for what happens when two devices edit the same file.

- Uploads of files over 1 GiB are now up to 40% faster, thanks to a new chunking strategy. The default chunk size grows from 8 MiB to 16 M
